title: Portfolio Allocation under Heterogeneous Scales and Multifractality
abstract: arXiv:2608.04987v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cross-correlations between financial signals are neither scale-free nor amplitude-independent: they vary with the time scale over which they are measured and with the magnitude of the fluctuations that dominate the average. We exploit this structure to construct a portfolio allocation model in which the risk functional is the signed fluctuation function of multifractal cross-correlation analysis (MFCCA), indexed by a scale $s$ and a fluctuation order $q$. Unlike MFDCCA-type criteria, which rectify local detrended covariances before aggregation, MFCCA retains their sign, so that co-moving and counter-moving components contribute to risk with opposite signs; for $q=2$ the resulting quadratic form coincides with the detrended fluctuation function of the portfolio series itself, recovering the mean--variance criterion as a scale-dependent limit. translated_title: 异质尺度与多重分形下的投资组合配置
translated_abstract: 金融信号之间的交叉相关性既不具有尺度不变性，也与幅度无关：它们随测量所处的时间尺度以及主导平均值计算的波动幅度而变化。我们利用这一结构构建了一个投资组合配置模型，其中风险泛函是多分形交叉相关分析（MFCCA）的带符号波动函数，由尺度 $s$ 和波动阶数 $q$ 索引。与MFDCCA类准则在聚合前对局部去趋势协方差进行取绝对值（整流）处理不同，MFCCA保留了其符号，使得同向波动与反向波动分量以相反的符号对风险作出贡献；当 $q=2$ 时，所得的二次型与投资组合序列本身的去趋势波动函数相一致，从而将均值-方差准则恢复为尺度依赖的极限情形。利用双分量ARFIMA过程和马尔可夫切换多分形过程，我们证明了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出以多分形交叉相关分析（MFCCA）的带符号波动函数作为风险泛函的投资组合配置模型，通过保留去趋势协方差的符号使同向与反向波动以相反符号贡献于风险，并在 q=2 时将经典均值-方差准则恢复为尺度依赖的极限情形。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a portfolio allocation model whose risk functional is the signed fluctuation function of multifractal cross-correlation analysis (MFCCA), retaining the sign of detrended covariances so that co-moving and counter-moving components contribute to risk with opposite signs, and recovering the mean-variance criterion as a scale-dependent limit at q=2.
